# Yaki Labs — Free Shopify Apps for Growth & AOV

> High-converting Shopify apps for product bundles, cross-sells, free gift rewards, and advanced discount logic. 100% Free forever.

---

## The 3 Apps by Yaki Labs

### 1. Buy X Get Y, Bundles & Upsell (Yaki Bundles & Cross-Sell) — Flagship
- **App Store URL**: https://apps.shopify.com/yaki-bundle-cross-sell
- **Price**: 100% Free Forever
- **Primary Goal**: Boost Average Order Value (AOV) with Shopify-native product bundles, volume discounts, and BOGO deals.
- **Key Features**:
  - **Product Bundles & Mix-and-Match**: Combine complementary products into discounted bundles with one-click cart additions.
  - **Buy X Get Y (BOGO)**: Buy 1 Get 1 Free, Buy 2 Get 1 50% Off, flexible quantity/variant conditions.
  - **Volume Discounts & Quantity Breaks**: "Buy 2 Save 10%, Buy 3 Save 20%" tiered pricing tables right on product pages.
  - **Free Gift with Purchase**: Reward cart thresholds or specific bundles with automatic free items.
  - **Upsell & Cross-Sell**: Showcase high-margin add-ons on product pages and drawers.
  - **Zero Coding**: Fully customizable widgets matching any Shopify theme seamlessly.
  - **Shopify Functions Powered**: Fast, server-side execution directly integrated into Shopify checkout.

### 2. Free Gift Helper (Buy X Get Y Free Gifts & BOGOs)
- **App Store URL**: https://apps.shopify.com/free-gift-helper
- **Price**: 100% Free Forever (Rated 5.0 ★ by merchants)
- **Primary Goal**: Delight customers and eliminate cart abandonment with on-store reward experiences.
- **Key Features**:
  - **Milestone Progress Bar**: Dynamic tier bars showing customers how close they are to free gifts and free shipping.
  - **Auto-Add Gifts**: Automatically place gift items into cart when threshold criteria are met.
  - **Gift Selection Popups**: Allow buyers to choose their favorite gift variants from beautiful modal interfaces.
  - **BOGO Promos**: Automated Buy One Get One offers applied smoothly at checkout.

### 3. Yaki Discount Script (Discount Script App)
- **App Store URL**: https://apps.shopify.com/discount-script-app
- **Price**: 100% Free Forever
- **Primary Goal**: The modern visual replacement for deprecated Shopify Scripts.
- **Key Features**:
  - **Visual Rule Builder**: Drag-and-drop conditions for complex product, order, and shipping discounts.
  - **Precise Line-Item Targeting**: Include/exclude products by collections, tags, customer segments, or vendor.
  - **Automated Scheduling**: Deploy seasonal promotions on schedule.
  - **Discount Combinations**: Full control over stacking rules without touching Ruby or Liquid code.
